name: hive-sdk
description: Live crypto data for AI agents: nine tools for token search, prices, token safety, token research, wallets, derivatives positioning, the market overview, DeFi yields and prediction markets, each answer citing its sources.

interface.shortDescription: Live crypto data for agents, with cited sources.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT and Codex to Hive's hosted MCP server: nine tools that each answer one research job (find a token, price, token safety, token research, wallets, derivatives positioning, the market overview, DeFi yields and prediction markets). Every section of an answer names its provider, fetch time and runtime status.
defaultPrompt: Research this token: is it real, liquid and safe?
What does this wallet hold, and what has it been doing?
Is BTC crowded long? Show funding, open interest and liquidations.
